links.outcome: Specificity of ICH detection by patient age subgroup
links.effect: Specificity fell with age: 96.95% in <50 years, 93.04% in 50-70 years, 88.54% in >70 years; FP cases were significantly older (56.3 vs 40.5 years, p<0.001).
links.quote: Specificity demonstrated an inverse relationship with patient age (96.95% in < 50 years, 93.04% in 50-70 years, and 88.54% in > 70 years).

links.outcome: Local diagnostic accuracy of ICH algorithm against radiologist reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 98.17%, specificity 94.71%, NPV 99.70% at ICH prevalence 13.4%; 74 false positives and 96 subtyping errors, with over-labeling.
links.quote: The algorithm demonstrated 98.17% sensitivity, 94.71% specificity and 99.70% NPV for hemorrhage detection.

screen.reason: This study conducts an offline retrospective validation of an existing clinical AI tool (Hevi AI) for intracranial hemorrhage detection, analyzing real-world error patterns and demographic disparities (age-related misclassification) without testing an explicit implementation or safeguard practice.
